assets.name: knowledge
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original photoreal editorial cutout for an agent-framework diagram, square composition, genuinely transparent background. A coherent material language of warm ivory paper, satin aluminium, smoked periwinkle optical glass, and one restrained cobalt accent. Exceptional physical material detail, fine edges, precise bevels, subtle microtexture, soft large-source studio light from upper left, elegant shallow three-quarter perspective. Objects should occupy about 82% of the image, centered with clear margins. A small tightly composed material study that remains recognizable at 200px. This should look like carefully art-directed product photography. Very thin, refined pieces, not bulky or chunky. No environment, no floor, no opaque backdrop, no external cast shadow, no clay, no cartoon, no toy keycaps, no inflated plastic, no neon, no sparkles, no tubes, no wallpaper, no watermark. Subject: a small archive of three offset ivory document sheets held inside a thin open translucent periwinkle index sleeve. The front document has precise black editorial typesetting represented by a bold horizontal heading and five short fine lines; another sheet has a simple small outlined three-node knowledge graph. A discreet cobalt index tab projects above one sheet. Fine paper edges and the glass sleeve's restrained blue refraction communicate knowledge with depth. No readable words or random letter strings. The papers are the subject, not a file cabinet or a chunky folder. Crisp and sophisticated.

assets.name: product-2d
assets.method: Built-in image_gen generation with a material reference
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an original 2D editorial product illustration for the output of an agent-framework connection diagram. Image 1 is ONLY a material and palette reference; do not copy its objects, its typography card, or its perspective. Create a brand-new composition. STRICTLY STRAIGHT-ON, FLAT TWO-DIMENSIONAL GRAPHIC: no isometric view, no tilted window, no extrusion, no thick 3D sides. A sophisticated custom product interface is the main subject, with an agent naturally integrated into its right side. Design this as a beautifully composed illustration, not a literal functional dashboard screenshot. One large ivory rounded-rectangle application frame, a slim graphite header with a small elegant cobalt brand glyph, a narrow quiet navigation rail, and an asymmetrical editorial content area. Use one striking cobalt/periwinkle geometric editorial image, a few precisely aligned graphite typographic bars, and generous breathing room. The right-hand agent area should feel like a thin translucent periwinkle sheet integrated with the app: a small simple conversation symbol, two very short message shapes, and one understated completion check. Let one small contextual sheet overlap the lower edge to express the agent acting inside the product. Crisp precise 2D geometry with fine ivory paper grain, restrained frosted-glass surface texture, very thin silver contour details and tiny soft contact shadows; match the sophistication and colors of the reference while keeping the drawing flat. Palette limited to ivory, pearl, charcoal, muted blue and a small deep cobalt accent. No gradients sprayed behind the artwork. The illustration must be instantly readable at 350 pixels, with a few large well-composed forms instead of many tiny elements. No task list, no checkboxes, no project management table, no dark chat box, no fake conversation paragraphs, no readable text, no letters, no labels, no screenshot, no computer device, no toy, no clay, no inflated plastic, no robot, no sparkles, no neon, no watermark. Center the whole illustration within a square transparent canvas, occupying about 88% of its width and 80% of its height. True transparent background with clean alpha, no opaque outer background, no floor, no cast shadow beyond the composition.

Make the blue panel feel like a 2D frosted overlay rather than a physical box or envelope. Simple quiet silhouette, restrained rounded corners. No readable words, no letters, no perspective or depth, no open folder box.
